about.title: Hi, Abdoul here!
about.subtitle: Get to know me better
about.bio1: I'm a passionate AI/ML Engineer and Software Engineer with expertise in building intelligent systems and scalable web applications.
about.bio2: Currently pursuing my degree in Computer Science, I combine academic knowledge with hands-on experience in machine learning, deep learning, and modern development.
about.bio3: My journey in tech started with curiosity about how machines can learn and make decisions. Today, I work on projects ranging from natural language processing to computer vision.

randomFacts.title: Random facts about me
randomFacts.description: When I'm not training models or debugging complex algorithms, I'm usually recharging my own neural network. Here’s a glimpse into the human side of the stack—what drives me, what fuels me, and what keeps me grounded.

coffee.title: My fuel source
coffee.description: I don't just drink coffee; I compile it into code. It is the essential training data for my daily productivity.

dream.title: My dream
dream.description: To leverage Artificial Intelligence to create systems that leave a lasting, positive dent in the universe. I want to build technology that improves lives on a global scale.

soccer.title: Soccer
soccer.description: My favorite way to clear the cache. Whether watching or playing, it’s the only place where running in loops is actually a good strategy.

priorities.title: My priorities
priorities.description: Family comes first, always. After that? Writing clean code, devouring personal growth books, and never deploying to production on a Friday.

roots.title: My Roots
roots.description: Born and raised in Niger. My heritage shapes my perspective, my values, and keeps me grounded no matter where code takes me.

location.title: My HQ
location.description: Based in Quebec, Canada. Surviving the sub-zero winters thanks to the heat from my GPU.

backend.description: Designing scalable APIs and microservices that power complex applications.

ml-sentiment-analysis.title: ML Sentiment Analysis Engine
ml-sentiment-analysis.description: A deep learning model for real-time sentiment analysis using transformers and BERT, achieving 94% accuracy on benchmark datasets.

ai-chatbot-platform.title: AI Chatbot Platform
ai-chatbot-platform.description: An intelligent chatbot platform using LLMs with RAG architecture for contextual conversations and document Q&A.

mlops-pipeline.title: End-to-End MLOps Pipeline
mlops-pipeline.description: A comprehensive MLOps infrastructure with automated training, testing, model versioning, and deployment workflows.

computer-vision-detection.title: Object Detection System

portfolio-website.description: Modern portfolio website built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS featuring dark mode and smooth animations.

master.description: Specialization in AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision. Conducting applied research on 3D reconstruction using HoloLens 2.

life.description: Because the documentation updates faster than the curriculum. Committed to learning something new every single day.
